name: Easy Sheet Pan Moroccan Cod with New Potatoes, Tomatoes & Cucumber Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
680 g new potatoes
½ lemon
½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
2 pint grape tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Place spices in a small bowl and stir to combine the spice mix.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp paprika
1 tsp coriander, ground
1 tsp cumin, ground
1 tsp salt
1 tsp black pepper
¼ tsp cinnamon, ground

instructions.primary_message: Halve new potatoes. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then sprinkle with about 1/3 of the spice mix. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve remaining spice mix for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until potatoes are starting to soften, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and medium dice cucumber. Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add both to the bowl with the dressing, stir to combine the salad, and set aside.
Place grape tomatoes in another medium bowl, along with oil and half of the remaining spice mix, then stir to coat. Set aside.
Pat cod dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Drizzle with oil, then season both sides with the remaining spice mix.
instructions.secondary_message:
680 g cod fillet
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: When the potatoes are starting to soften, remove baking sheet from the oven. Add tomatoes, stir to combine, then spread back out in an even layer. Add fish, nestling it into the veggies, then return baking sheet to the oven. Continue to roast until potatoes are fork-tender and cod is cooked through, 12-15 minutes more. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide fish, roasted veggies, and cucumber salad between plates. Enjoy!
